test_explode_multiple: test the DataFrame.explode() method with multiple list columns using selector and argument forms
test_explode_empty_df: test DataFrame.explode() on empty DataFrames with large_list Arrow type preserves correct dtype
test_explode_empty_list: test DataFrame.explode() when list columns contain empty lists producing null values in non-list columns
test_explode_invalid_element_count: test that DataFrame.explode() raises ShapeError when exploded columns have mismatched element counts
test_explode_array: test DataFrame.explode() on Array dtype columns and LazyFrame explode with selector expressions
test_explode_params: test DataFrame.explode() with empty_as_null and keep_nulls parameters controlling null and empty list behavior
test_explode_inner_null: test that exploding a List(Null) column produces a Null dtype DataFrame
test_explode_struct_nulls: test DataFrame.explode() on list of struct columns with null and empty list items
test_explode_nullable_list: test DataFrame.explode() on nullable list columns with when/then conditional construction
test_explode_binary: test Series.list.explode() on a List(Binary) dtype preserving binary values
